title: Smallpox up there
html_source:
Annual Report of the Local Government Board for Ireland for the Year Ended March, 1905 (p. 505)
Report by Dr. Clibborn, Medical Inspector, on small-pox outbreak in Belfast city (April 1st, 1904 to February 28th, 1905) …
The total number of cases that occurred between these dates was 137, bringing the total number of cases in this outbreak between October, 1903 and February 28th, 1905, to 178.

anchor.prefix: ping. Give you the needle that would. Can't he hear the difference? Think he's that way inclined a bit. Against my grain somehow. Thought that Belfast would fetch him. I hope that
anchor.suffix:
doesn't get worse. Suppose she wouldn't let herself be vaccinated again. Your wife and my wife.

 Wonder is he pimping after me?
